owner_directive.cane_shaft_exception: continuous 1px white shaft with original dark outline

method.cluster_vote: frozen snapshot; adjacent legal material-ramp tones only

curation_learning: Owner authorization of a semantic color zone must be represented as a named mask and counted separately from other uses of that palette index.
The cane is a deliberate 1px structural exception; uniform color and outline continuity are more useful checks than a generic 2x2 threshold.

A mask-constrained clustering pass can remove supported shade islands but cannot safely merge pixels separated from all legal same-material tones without changing semantic ownership or outline geometry.

Hair-color validation must inspect the material mask and the visible hairline. A color-clean mask can still miss a red source component at the fringe; recover that component only when it is anchored to the gray hair and outside the skin-face region.
A zero semantic-leak report is not equivalent to a clean cluster audit or artistic approval; the candidate remains failed while any mandated cluster gate is nonzero.
next_gate: Do not promote. Owner visual review of the 1x/4x sample; then obtain explicit scope approval before touching outline or material ownership to resolve remaining isolated components.
